summary: Full-stack testing of MSPShield MVP (landing + admin + lead API). Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass (health, lead validation, admin auth, stats, status transitions). Frontend: landing renders all sections, ROI calculator live-updates, FAQ accordion works, CTA form submit → success screen + Telegram-less lead persisted and visible in /admin/leads. Admin auth + status PATCH flow works. Two real bugs found: Pricing CTA prefill is only visual (React state never updated) and horizontal overflow on mobile (390px).

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking plan-bronze/silver/gold-cta sets the <select id=f-tariff> DOM value directly (sel.value = id) but does NOT update React state of CTAForm. Form submission still sends tariff='undecided'. Confirmed in admin table: lead created after clicking silver CTA saved as 'undecided'.

document.scrollWidth > clientWidth → horizontal overflow on mobile. Likely culprits: CTA form grid (1fr 460px, media query only at 960px — fine there but some child uses fixed width) or pricing min-width cell, or Compare/Tools tables. Needs overflow-x:hidden on body or responsive tweak.

Empty submit relies solely on HTML5 'required' (browser native popup) rather than showing the custom toast. Spec mentions 'error toast on empty form' — currently browser blocks submit before onSubmit fires, so toast.error is never triggered. UX-wise OK, but doesn't match spec expectation of toast.

integration_issues.issue: Selected tariff is lost between Pricing click and lead POST because state is not synced (see Pricing.jsx bug above).

action_items: Fix Pricing.jsx: replace DOM-mutation `sel.value = id` with a cross-component state sync. Options: (a) lift tariff to URL hash / context and read in CTAForm, (b) dispatch a CustomEvent('prefill-tariff', {detail: id}) that CTAForm listens for and calls setForm, (c) use a small Zustand/Context store for the landing state. After fix, verify admin row shows correct tariff after clicking a plan CTA.
Investigate mobile horizontal overflow at 390px — add `overflow-x: hidden` on body or identify the offending wide element (likely Compare table or CTA grid fixed column).
(Optional) Trigger toast.error explicitly when form is empty by switching `required` to manual JS validation, to match spec wording.
critical_code_review_comments: Pricing.onPick bypasses React state by mutating DOM directly — anti-pattern; breaks controlled input semantics.

CTAForm uses document.querySelector to read calc-result instead of lifting state or context — fragile cross-component coupling; calc-verdict/result structure change would silently break downtime_loss.
server.py list_leads excludes _id correctly via projection {'_id': 0} — good.
Tariff PATCH endpoint takes new_status as query param (`/status?new_status=...`) — works, but a JSON body would be more idiomatic.
No rate limiting on POST /api/leads — public endpoint is spam-vulnerable; consider slowapi or reverse-proxy limits before go-live.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is technically contradictory (browsers ignore credentials with wildcard). Not blocking, but tighten for prod.
seed_data_creation: Tests created 3+ TEST_-prefixed leads via POST /api/leads (used for list/stats/patch assertions). They remain in DB for next agent's regression runs — safe to leave, not interfering with production data (DB is fresh MVP).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_mspshield_api.py — run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Relies on ADMIN_TOKEN=change-me-to-strong-random-string. Current lead count was ~4 after this iteration. Two open frontend bugs: Pricing tariff prefill + mobile overflow. When retesting: click plan-gold-cta, submit the form without manually touching f-tariff, then verify the new row in /admin/leads shows tariff='gold' (currently shows 'undecided').
rca of the issue: Pricing.onPick runs `setTimeout(() => { document.getElementById('f-tariff').value = id }, 600)`. This directly mutates the DOM value of a controlled React <select>. React's next render (triggered by any parent re-render, reveal observer, toast mount, etc.) resets the select back to `form.tariff` ('undecided'). Even if React doesn't re-render, `form.tariff` state is never updated, so the submitted payload uses the stale state value. Fix: introduce state sync — e.g. a lightweight global store or a window-level event: in Pricing dispatch `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('msp:set-tariff', {detail: id}))`; in CTAForm useEffect add listener that does `setForm(p => ({ ...p, tariff: e.detail }))`. Alternatively use React context or Zustand.
